properties.description: The 180-query criterion-1 corpus: one query per served tool, phrased as a user states the job — never the tool's name, never a phrase lifted from its description. Authored 2026-09-11 by an agent that had read every description, so informed rather than blind; a query from a field report supersedes the one here. Read by every_tool_is_found_by_a_query_in_the_users_words.rs via include_str!, so adding a tool without a query fails the build.
properties.name: find_tools_corpus.json
